name: bm25_rag
description: Sparse retrieval baseline (family A, BASELINE_METRIC_PLAN.md §4): chunks the conversation by turn, indexes with BM25 (rank_bm25), retrieves the top-k turns for each question, and answers from just those instead of the full transcript. Comparison point for whether a real memory framework beats plain lexical retrieval.
author: Wnsdnl
